lines: 2026 Iran war 2026 Iran war ceasefire Supreme National Security Council Secretary Mohsen Rezaee says that Iran has set seven conditions for resuming ceasefire negotiations with the United States. (Iran International)
2026 Atlantic hurricane season Tropical Depression Six forms in the Atlantic Ocean near the Azores amidst a unusually quiet Atlantic hurricane season caused by El Niño. (WTSP) (Fox Weather)

2026 Indonesia wildfires, Indonesia–Malaysia relations Indonesia accepts Malaysian assistance to combat wildfires in Kalimantan, including a Bombardier CL-415MP aircraft, three helicopters, and 52 personnel, as the fires cause transboundary haze affecting Southeast Asia. (AFP via France 24)
Eritrea–United States relations The U.S. treasury department lifts the sanctions against Eritrea's ruling party previously imposed by former U.S. president Joe Biden's administration. (AP)

2026 Russian legislative election Russian election commission chairperson Ella Pamfilova reports cyberattacks targeting Russia's online voting system during the second day of the parliamentary election and says they are repelled. The Minkomsvyaz separately reports thwarting a sabotage attempt on Far Eastern communication lines. (ABC News Australia)
2026 South Ossetian presidential election Marat Kambolov is declared the winner of the presidential elections in the partially recognized South Ossetia. (Reuters)

2026 World Rugby Pacific Nations Cup In rugby union, hosts Japan win their fourth Pacific Nations Cup title after defeating the defending champions Fiji 20–15 in the final at Chichibunomiya Stadium in Tokyo. (AFP via RFI)
